checks.text: On initial load, the page shows the heading "Tic Tac Toe", the text "Player X's turn", and the score line "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 0".
Clicking the cell in row 1, column 1 places an "X" in that cell, changes the turn indicator to "Player O's turn", and the cell is no longer clickable.
After clicking cell (1,1) for X and cell (2,2) for O, clicking cell (3,3) places an "X" in that cell, displays the text "Player X wins", and updates the score line to "X: 1, O: 0, Draws: 0".
After a win, clicking any empty cell does not change the board or the turn indicator, and the text "Player X wins" remains visible.
Clicking the button "Restart" after a win clears the board, resets the turn indicator to "Player X's turn", and keeps the score line as "X: 1, O: 0, Draws: 0".
Playing a draw by filling cells (1,1) X, (1,2) O, (1,3) X, (2,1) O, (2,2) X, (2,3) O, (3,1) X, (3,2) O, (3,3) X displays the text "Draw" and updates the score line to "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 1".
After a draw, clicking the button "Reset Scores" clears the score line to "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 0" and clears the board.
Pressing the key "1" while the board has focus places an "X" in cell (1,1), and pressing "5" places an "O" in cell (2,2).

Reload keeps the score and board state: after playing X at (1,1) and O at (1,2), reloading the page still shows "X" in cell (1,1), "O" in cell (1,2), the turn indicator "Player X's turn", and the score line "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 0".
